scenarios.name: metalcraft-two-artifacts-is-short
scenarios.why: Mox Opal plus one other artifact is only two artifacts, so its restricted mana ability cannot be activated.

scenarios.name: metalcraft-three-artifacts-mox-produces-mana
scenarios.why: With Mox Opal and two other artifacts, the metalcraft restriction is met and tapping it for its mana ability adds one chosen color of mana.
